A young woman with short, reddish-brown hair, wearing a white camisole and a fuzzy beige cardigan, is seated and speaking. She gestures toward her throat and head with her right hand, her facial expression conveying discomfort and fatigue. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The camera cuts to a young man seated at a desk, wearing a white medical coat and a stethoscope around his neck. He has dark hair and a professional yet casual demeanor. Behind him, various posters and a shelf with books are visible. He listens attentively to the woman and then begins to speak, gesturing with his hands. (3) The man puts on the stethoscope's earpieces and leans toward the woman. He places the stethoscope's chest piece on her upper chest. As he does so, both characters' expressions shift from professional to intensely dramatic and romanticized, looking into each other's eyes. (4) A rapid montage sequence begins, characterized by high-contrast and dream-like lighting. It includes scenes of a bride and groom at an altar, hands exchanging rings, and various characters in outdoor and indoor settings expressing extreme emotions like crying, shouting, and joyful laughter. The editing is fast-paced. (5) The video returns to the office setting where the man and woman are now in a heated, melodramatic confrontation. The man grabs the woman's arms, and they exchange emotionally charged dialogue. Finally, they embrace in a long, tight hug, with the woman crying on the man's shoulder.
